contexts.text: The Lord, who is all in all of His Kingdom and of His Church.
Everything celestial and spiritual... is from the Lord alone, from which the Lord is all in all of His Heaven...
Heaven is called the Grand Man from this especially, that the Lord is all in all there.
All the people from the outermost = each and all of them.

The Divine can only inflow into what is Divine, or can only be communicated to man through the Lord's Divine Human and Holy [Proceeding]. Hence may be understood what it is for the Lord to be all in all of His Kingdom.
All, in the inward sense = everything, or all things.
Each and all things in the Word in the highest sense have respect to the Lord... and therefore they have respect to His Kingdom, for the Lord is all in His Kingdom. Explained.
In process of time every Church decreases.
With man, interior things are everything, and exterior things... in which he places everything, are relatively scarcely anything.
The Lord is all in all of His Kingdom, and whatever therein is not from Him and has not respect to Him, is not of His Kingdom. AC 6821.
Because I have all things = his spiritual riches.
The whole of life, thus the whole of wisdom and intelligence.
Heaven properly so called is the Lord, for He is all in all there.
It is said in the plural, Every land came to Egypt.
We are twelve brethren = all truths in one complex. Twelve = all.
Those in your houses = each and all things of good from truth; thus for food for them in your houses = good of truth in each and all things. Explained.
This reigns singularly, that is, in each and all things.
If man could be introduced into Heaven merely of the Lord's mercy, all in Hell would be elevated into Heaven, for the Lord's mercy is towards all.
Heaven, where the Divine Human is everything. Explained... Hence it is that the Divine Human in the Heavens is everything in their intuitions, and thence everything in their faith and love.
Divine truth proceeding from the Lord makes Heaven... hence it is said that the Lord is all in all of Heaven, and that they who are in Heaven are said to be in the Lord. AC 9166:4.
In Heaven Divine good united to Divine truth is all in all, thus is the life or soul of Heaven.

Everything good and everything true are from the Lord... the Angels... have a perception that this is the case, hence it is that their life is the Lord's life in them... From this it is evident what it is for the Lord to be all in all of Heaven, and for Him to be Heaven.

One solid of pure gold = a whole quantity, thus all from good... By what is wholly from good... is meant when good is all in all, not only in truths... but also in scientifics... Good is all in the products and derivatives.

So the end is all of the cause, and the cause is all of the effect; hence it follows that the end is all of the effect... So from the Celestial is all the Spiritual; from the Spiritual is all the Natural; that is, from the Celestial through the Spiritual.

Hence it is evident that the first is all in the products and derivatives... The Divine is the first of all... wherefore it is all in all of the order of things, thus in all things of good and truth... consequently good from the Divine is in all truths of faith, and if good be not all in them, and if the Lord's Divine be not all in good, man has not anything of Heaven or of the Church in him.

The Lord's Divine is in all things of good, and thence in all things of truth with man, when man wills from love and believes from faith thence derived that all good and all truth, thus all of love and all of faith are from the Lord, and nothing whatever from himself...
All when said of Heaven = everywhere.
Repetition involves that it was so in each and all.

The Lord does not dwell in anything proper to man or Angel, but in His own with them; hence it is that when Heaven and the Church are mentioned, the Lord's Divine with those who are there is understood; from which it is evident how it is to be comprehended that the Lord is all in all of Heaven and the Church. AC 10151:3.
To dwell Myself in the midst of them = the Lord's Divine, that it is all in all of Heaven and the Church. Explained.
Everyone with whom is the Church is saved; but everyone with whom the Church is not is condemned.
The first degree is all in all in the following degrees. General article.

Hence it may be clearly seen that the Divine, which is substance in itself, that is, the one and only substance, is the substance from which is each and every created thing; thus that God is the all in all things of the Universe.
The Infinite is the all...
That which remains for ever is in itself perpetually something, thus is everything.
The Divine form [of Heaven] can only consist and be permanent when the Lord is all in all, and the [Angels] are nothing whatever.

That salvation depends upon the knowledge and acknowledgement of God is evident to everyone who reflects that God is all in all of Heaven, and thence all in all of the Church, consequently all in all of theology.
Truth and good are the beginnings of all things in both worlds... wherefore these two are all in all.
The Lord, through the Word, is all in all of Heaven. Explained.
